footer.local: Your data stays in this browser: no servers, no accounts.

hide.label: Hide amounts
hide.explain: Replaces figures with ••••• so you can use the app in public. It's only a visual effect: data is still saved in plain text in the browser and exports.

welcome.title: Your net worth, finally clear.
welcome.body: Enter what you own and what you owe: in a few minutes you'll see what your share is really worth. Everything stays in this browser.

one.title: No account
one.body: No registration, no server, no bank connection.

two.title: Your share, not the total
two.body: Home at 50%? Company at 10%? Only the part that's yours counts.

three.title: Snapshots over time
three.body: Save a snapshot whenever you want and see what changes.

demo.bannerBody: People and numbers are fictional. You can edit everything: when you exit, the demo disappears and your data stays as it was.

items.homeNote: 50% co-ownership: the entered value is for the whole home.
items.usNote: Amount in USD, converted with the demo's manual exchange rate.

summary.liquidityHint: Accounts, cash, and deposits: money you can actually use.
summary.negativeHint: Debts exceed assets. It can happen, for example, in the first years of a mortgage: the number is here to show the situation, not to judge it.
summary.compositionHint: Percentages of total assets. Debts are separate.
summary.sinceLastHint: Net worth difference from that snapshot (not a return).
summary.noSnapshot: No snapshots yet. Save one to start your history.

investments.label: Investments
investments.hint: Funds, ETFs, stocks, bonds, retirement plans

liabilities.label: Debt
liabilities.hint: Mortgages, loans, cards: how much is left to repay

form.chooseTitle: What do you want to add?
form.chooseHint: Choose a category: we'll only ask for the fields you need.
form.assetHint: Enter the value and how much is yours: you'll see right away how much it counts in your net worth.
form.liabilityHint: Enter only the outstanding principal you owe. No amortization schedule needed.
form.name: Name

basis.shareHint: E.g. your account balance or the value of your shares.
basis.wholeHint: E.g. the value of the whole home: then you enter the percentage you own.

form.rateNeeded: To include this item in totals in {{currency}}, an exchange rate is needed. You enter it yourself: it's not a live quote.
form.linkedHint: Informational only: the debt is subtracted once, linked or not.

legacy.title: From the previous version: share shown as “{{value}}”
legacy.body: In the previous version, the amount was already treated as your share, and it still is. If it was the full value instead, choose “The asset's full value” and enter the percentage.

preview.title: Contribution to your net worth
preview.empty: Enter a valid amount to see the preview.
preview.share: The amount is already your share.
preview.liability: It is subtracted from net worth.

amount.invalid: I can't read this number. Try 12500 or 12,500.50.
amount.negative: The amount can't be negative. Debts are entered as debts.
amount.zero: The amount must be greater than zero.

percent.range: The percentage must be greater than 0 and at most 100.

holdings.search: Search by name, notes, or category
holdings.emptyAssets: Nothing here yet. Even the tidiest net worth started with one row.
holdings.emptyLiabilities: No debts recorded. If you have any, add them: net worth will be more realistic.

snapshot.dialogBody: Record a dated, immutable copy of assets, debts, values, and exchange rate. Later changes won't affect it.
snapshot.savedBody: Your net worth on {{date}} is safe in History.
snapshot.missingRate: Set the exchange rate first: some items can't be converted.
snapshot.empty: There's nothing to snapshot: add at least one item.

history.title: History
history.description: Snapshots of your net worth over time. They start from the first one you save: no invented values.
history.emptyBody: Save the first snapshot: it's your starting point. Next time you update values, save another one and see the difference.
history.trendHint: Net worth, assets, and debts in {{currency}}.
history.notConvertible_one: {{count}} snapshot has no recorded exchange rate and doesn't appear in the chart in this currency.
history.notConvertible_other: {{count}} snapshots have no recorded exchange rate and don't appear in the chart in this currency.
history.diffUnavailable: Difference not available in this currency
history.convertedNote: converted from {{currency}} with the exchange rate from then
history.detailCurrency: Values in {{currency}}, as at the time it was taken
history.immutable: Snapshots can't be edited: they show what your net worth looked like at that moment.
history.deleteBody: The snapshot will be removed from history. Current data won't change.
history.conventionCurrency: Each snapshot keeps the currency and exchange rate in effect when you saved it. If you view it in another currency, it's converted with that exchange rate, not today's: changing the current exchange rate doesn't rewrite the past.
history.conventionReturn: The difference between two snapshots includes everything: new assets, repayments, new estimates, and exchange rate. It's a change in value, not a financial return.

whatIf.title: What if…?
whatIf.description: A quick test: your data won't change.

purchase.explain: You buy an asset using cash: value moves from accounts to the asset. If you're short on cash, enter how much you'd finance with debt.
purchase.financedHint: Leave blank if you pay entirely with cash.

revalue.explain: Change an asset's estimate by a percentage. Only this changes net worth.
revalue.none: Add at least one asset first.

repay.explain: Repay part of the debt with cash: cash and debt both go down by the same amount.
repay.none: You have no debts to repay. Good news.

whatIf.footnote: Simple accounting simulation: no taxes, costs, interest, or forecasts. This is not financial advice.

about.title: How it works
about.body: 3ASYWEALTH is a small free tool for understanding your net worth. It's part of 3ASY.APP. No accounts, no servers, no bank connections: everything works in your browser.

share.a: For each asset, choose whether the amount is already your share or the whole asset value with your percentage. The percentage is applied only once.

liquidity.a: Only the Cash category: accounts, cash, deposits. Homes, business stakes, and investments are not available money.

debts.a: Enter the outstanding principal you owe. Net worth is assets minus debts. Linking a debt to an asset is only a reminder: it doesn't subtract it twice.

snapshots.a: They fix net worth at a precise moment, with the exchange rate from then. That way you can compare over time without today's changes rewriting the past.

privacy.a: In this browser's local storage, in plain text. It isn't sent to anyone and isn't encrypted: anyone using this device can see it. Make regular backups.

pdf.title: Net worth summary
pdf.rateLine: Values in {{currency}} · manual exchange rate 1 EUR = {{rate}} USD (set: {{date}})
pdf.missingRate: Warning: {{count}} items in another currency are not included because the exchange rate is missing.
pdf.netExplain: Net worth = assets attributed to you − outstanding debts you owe. Cash = only accounts, cash, and deposits.
pdf.note1: Amounts are estimates entered by the user. Each asset is counted for the owned share; debts for the personal outstanding principal, only once.
pdf.note2: The EUR/USD exchange rate is entered manually and is not a market quote. Amounts are calculated to the cent.
pdf.note3: Document generated locally in the browser by 3ASYWEALTH. This is not financial advice or an official document.
